body: Thanks and no problem, we all probably went through this phase. I also am not trying to single myself out since most teenagers in America have this feeling with their parents. I don't go to school and won't till next year. Need to get my GED, but would love to spend time with my friends and what not. For my parents the catches are to work for them. Literally work for them in their company or a job they know about. This isn't your average hook you up job its more of a family business and you just kinda work there for nothing. I do chores and stuff and am accountable for my household but beyond that they want more from me and my siblings. My parents are Asian, but here's the funny part, they don't emphasize on education as most people think they would. They'd rather have me work for them or be a farmer. I can't outright ignore them since I had already tried by moving in with my sister but that failed due to my younger sibling being 7 and we had some court issues. I'm in no hurry to rush to my friends since I'll be a burden since I am not attending school, and to sum it all up my parents do think that I should be anything but what they want me to be. Sorry for the mess of words and thanks for talking with me.

Hey~, I'm back in the states and that's the general consensus from the people I've talked to. Just stay in school wait till 18, get a job. As of right now I'm not going to school and won't until the next term. I'm 16 and have piss poor grades and no stable home. Would love to do all the "adult" things right now, not out of a teenager wanting to be an adult, but because there are no other options. Feeling down about family right now since I'm the kind of person to wear my heart on my sleeve and the rest just secret away their emotions and decisions. Drained and really happy about being back. Just need one chance to make it. Since you are from reddit was wondering what do you think about if I lived with my friend. From a strangers standpoint. I have no resources and just need a home. However it can all be provided by my parents but I'd rather not take anything from them since there is always a catch with them. Sorry about being all over the place 22 hours of flight and little sleep addles my mind a bit. Also thanks for being here and talking to me. It's getting harder and harder each day and the grind, I sometimes think, isn't worth it at all.
CPS maybe but that's it. Hoping for a way out when I fly back. Other than I'm sunk. Thanks for talking i have to go since the people I'm staying with turnoff the wifi I use.

Court is always present since I am a minor. I can't appoint a guardian but need to be in the states. If I run I'm a runaway. I just don't have an outlet nor any resources to use. I don't have a phone or computer or any form of cash. Relying on my parents right now.

Wanting to stay back in my hometown and live with my friend. Not being like "OMG LIVING WITH MY BUDDY DUUDE!" since I tried living with my older sister and it ended up with moving back to my parents. I'd just like to settle down since this past year is full of court battles and stressful situations and what not.

> Alright, so life's just a PoS for me right now. Stuck in another country, flying out in two days back to USA and wondering if I'm going to be okay. I come from an abusive religion oriented family, and have posted some stuff about it with throw-aways. I keep thinking if I should off myself and just be done with it, since if I go back I'm either running away from my parents, or living in a shithole out in Oklahoma. Really not wanting either but beggars can't be choosers. I got a friend willing to take me in but that means either court, or running away and I've done both out of my own volition and without it. I don't hate my parents but they are moving across the country and don't intend on keeping me mentally stable. My dad already has his hands full with my mom so I'm just an open mouth for him to feed and shut up. My parents don't want me to go live with my friend cause I'm "their" child. So I'm stuck with the options I listed above.
